working_definition: Hindgut epithelial cells in the Malpighian tubule analysis (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class epithelial cell; asterisk meaning unknown).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult hindgut epithelium (FBbt:00047168).

justification: Label names the adult hindgut; cell-level equivalent (epithelial class per authors) is adult hindgut epithelial cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Posterior part of the adult alimentary canal, from the posterior end of the midgut to the rectum.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ term, not a cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Specialized epithelial cell of the adult hindgut.
